brand_identity.name: PROTOCOL
brand_identity.visual_style: Dark Mode, High Contrast, Brutalist Tech

landing_page.hero_section: Full viewport height (min-h-screen). Dark video/image background with black overlay (opacity-60). Centered massive typography.
landing_page.grid_system: Bento Grid (Mode A). Use 'Tetris' layout for features. Mixed col-spans.
landing_page.spacing: Generous. py-24 or py-32 between sections. Gap-8 for grids.

quiz_flow.progress_bar: Fixed top or sticky. Volt Blue fill. Height 4px.
quiz_flow.cards: Large click areas. Selected state: Border Volt Blue + Glow.

results_page.free_snapshot: High visibility. Count-up animations for calories/macros.
results_page.paywall_blur: Blur-md or blur-lg on the 'Detailed Plan' section. Overlay with Glassmorphism card.
results_page.sticky_cta: Mobile: Fixed bottom bar 'Unlock Full Protocol'.

buttons.style: Sharp edges (rounded-sm) or minimal radius (rounded-md). Uppercase text. Bold.

variants.default: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 shadow-lg hover:shadow-primary/20 transition-all duration-300
variants.outline: border-2 border-primary text-primary hover:bg-primary hover:text-white transition-all

inputs.style: bg-secondary border-transparent focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary h-12 text-lg px-4 rounded-md transition-all

cards.style: bg-card border border-border/40 hover:border-primary/50 transition-colors duration-300 rounded-lg p-6 or p-8

visual_enhancers.textures: Add a subtle 'noise' overlay opacity-5 to the background to kill digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px border with very low opacity (white/10) for structure.
visual_enhancers.icons: Lucide React. Stroke width 1.5px. Sharp or rounded depending on context.

motion.quiz_transition: AnimatePresence. Slide in from right, slide out to left.

universal_guidelines: Do not use generic gradients. Use solid colors or subtle noise.
Do not center align everything. Use asymmetry for tension.
Always add data-testid to interactive elements.
Ensure 3:1 contrast ratio for large text, 4.5:1 for normal text.
implementation_steps: 2. Create Layout Wrapper (Navbar, Footer, Background Noise).
4. Build Quiz Engine (State management, Steps, Progress).
5. Build Results Page (Calculation logic, Free vs Paid view).
7. Build PDF Generator (hidden, triggered after pay).
